description: Reviewer trusts a completed CI run for the exact task-branch commit as validation evidence instead of re-running it locally; without CI, the reviewer performs its own diff-scoped validation rather than trusting a bare implementer self-report.
verification: A reviewer with a completed, surface-covering CI run for the exact commit under review does not re-run the same checks locally
A reviewer with no such CI run performs its own validation scoped to the diff surface rather than trusting a bare implementer self-report
A completion or review report names exact commands and exit status, or a CI check run, rather than an unfalsifiable pass/fail assertion
